content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Melbourne

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of experience. Review your education and work history against PMI's criteria. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help verify your qualifications before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend interactive instructor-led sessions on your schedule across multiple weeks. You'll cover all five process groups and ten knowledge areas required by PMI's exam blueprint.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing Granite PM Academy's course, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI. Provide proof of your education, project experience, and completion of the 35-hour requirement. Pay the examination fee to PMI to secure your exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides tailored to the PMP blueprint. Schedule your computer-based exam with Pearson VUE. On exam day, demonstrate your project-management knowledge across 180 questions in a monitored testing environment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to a three-year renewal cycle. Earn 60 professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, or completing self-directed learning in project management. Renew with PMI every three years to keep your credential active and current.
